title: Identification of lipid metabolism-related biomarkers in familial hypercholesterolemia via integrated bioinformatics and machine learning approaches.
authors: Long, Linji; Zhu, Baosheng; Lv, Tao
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学和机器学习识别家族性高胆固醇血症的脂代谢相关生物标志物，虽含转录因子预测但非蛋白质-DNA互作建模核心，方法为常规机器学习而非AI/物理模拟，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Familial hypercholesterolemia (FH) is a genetic disorder characterized by imbalances in lipid metabolism, markedly increasing cardiovascular risk. Identifying lipid metabolism-related biomarkers is essential for understanding FH pathogenesis and developing therapeutic strategies. METHODS: A comprehensive bioinformatics analysis was conducted using 776 lipid metabolism-related genes (LMRGs) from the MSigDB database and the GSE6054 dataset containing 10 FH and 13 healthy samples. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) intersected with LMRGs to obtain candidate genes, followed by random forest and SVM-RFE machine learning to identify key biomarkers. Functional enrichment, subcellular localization, co-expression, transcription factor (TF) prediction, ceRNA network, and drug screening were subsequently performed. RESULTS: We identified 429 DEGs and 13 candidate genes, refined to six key genes (STAR, GRHL1, BZRAP1, LGMN, PLA2G4D, PLA2G12B). ROC analysis demonstrated that all six key genes exhibited AUC values greater than 0.7, underscoring their diagnostic potential. Functional enrichment further revealed significant associations with the ribosome and spliceosome pathways. Subcellular localization suggested mitochondrial and extracellular functions. Co-expression showed a significant positive correlation between GRHL1 and PLA2G12B. TF prediction revealed 17 TF-gene interactions, while ceRNA analysis outlined regulatory relationships. Drug prediction identified 224 potential therapeutic compounds, with STAR showing the most interactions. CONCLUSION: This study highlights six lipid metabolism-related biomarkers in FH through integrated bioinformatics and machine learning. These findings provide new insights into FH mechanisms and potential therapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 背景：家族性高胆固醇血症（familial hypercholesterolemia, FH）是一种以脂质代谢失衡为特征的遗传性疾病，显著增加心血管风险。识别脂质代谢相关生物标志物对于理解FH发病机制和制定治疗策略至关重要。方法：利用MSigDB数据库中的776个脂质代谢相关基因（LMRGs）和包含10个FH样本及13个健康样本的GSE6054数据集，进行了全面的生物信息学分析。将差异表达基因（DEGs）与LMRGs取交集以获得候选基因，随后采用随机森林和SVM-RFE机器学习方法识别关键生物标志物。进一步进行了功能富集、亚细胞定位、共表达、转录因子（TF）预测、ceRNA网络和药物筛选。结果：我们鉴定了429个DEGs和13个候选基因，并精炼出六个关键基因（STAR、GRHL1、BZRAP1、LGMN、PLA2G4D、PLA2G12B）。ROC分析显示，所有六个关键基因的AUC值均大于0.7，凸显了其诊断潜力。功能富集进一步揭示了与核糖体和剪接体通路的显著关联。亚细胞定位提示线粒体和细胞外功能。共表达分析显示GRHL1与PLA2G12B之间存在显著正相关。TF预测揭示了17个TF-基因相互作用，而ceRNA分析概述了调控关系。药物预测确定了224种潜在治疗化合物，其中STAR显示出最多的相互作用。结论：本研究通过整合生物信息学和机器学习，突出了FH中六个脂质代谢相关生物标志物。这些发现为FH机制和潜在治疗靶点提供了新见解。
